## Checks that I ran

Run these commands in PowerShell. Tick each box only if you ran the check.

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`

Windows version, PowerShell version, and Node.js version:

## Docs that I updated

- [ ] I updated the docs that the change affects.
- [ ] The change needs no doc update.
- [ ] A planned feature stays marked "Planned" until its code exists.

## Not tested or uncertain

<!-- Say which part of the change is a guess or is not tested. Write "None" if all is tested. -->

## Confirmations

- [ ] The change holds no secret, no cookie, no token, and no real session file.
- [ ] The change uses no real account in a test.
- [ ] The change is one logical change.
- [ ] The change adds no dependency that is not in `docs/PLAN.md`.
- [ ] The change does not edit a decision in `docs/DECISIONS.md` without approval.
